items.html: And there too, only the aspect of Atik of Beria is sorted, and there Arich of Beria is sorted, and within Arich, AVI of Beria are sorted, and so it continues in this manner always, for no part can be sorted above the place of its own level, neither in place nor in time, but rather all of them come one after another, both in the order of the levels and in the order of the time of their correction. This is clear, and enough said.
